learn.tipPt: Desafio = conversa completa, não lista de frases soltas.

learn.wrongEn: I'm going to meeting the client and I'll sent the invite and would you like dinner Friday all good.
learn.rightEn: I'm meeting the client on Thursday. I'll send the invite. Would you like to join us for dinner on Friday?
learn.explanationPt: Separe ideias. Arranjo = continuous. Promessa = will. Convite = would you like to.
